description.value: The Ruby on Johnson is a locally owned breakfast and brunch restaurant open since 2015, located inside the Best Western Carlton Plaza Hotel on Johnson Street in Victoria. It offers a refined take on brunch blending eclectic southern-inspired fare with scratch cooking and locally sourced ingredients. The restaurant is part of a small Victoria-based group with two additional locations and is known for its vinyl record collection and emphasis on staff wellbeing.
